sources.definition: Independent sewn external thread, 1 mm signed RH lead, one start, 4 mm axial depth; radius 6.3705/6.942 mm, 60 degree ruled profile, 0.125 mm crest width. Each full turn uses 64 cubic Hermite spans. Explicit construction vertex/sewing tolerance 0.00001 mm. No boolean or sweep and no customer CAD.
